Performance › Rendering

Performance › Streaming

Performance › Workers

Web Workers offload terrain and mesh generation to background threads for better performance.

0 = Auto (75% of CPU cores, rounded down). Manual max = CPU cores − 1. Higher values may improve chunk loading but use more resources.

Worker changes take effect on next world load.

Graphics › Materials

Per-pixel surface response — how shiny each material reads, and glass transparency.

Reflections ▾
Environment Reflections ▾

Shiny terrain texels (stone mica, bedrock specks, snow & sand sparkle) mirror the live sky gradient — tracks day/night. Needs Reflections (Shininess) on. Quality feature, off by default.
